Original portfolio design and development by Evangelos Giatsidis — https://giats.me

Source:
https://github.com/Giats2498/giats-portfolio/tree/1e0b7b0bfc0dce086a91c8d742c3c13cff6cf270/src/components/canvas/fluid

shaders.js contains the original Giats shader texts. cursor.js retains the
original splat, curl, vorticity, divergence, pressure, gradient, advection, and
display passes, using a small native WebGL2 host in place of React Three Fiber.
The port caps the render size and ends work when the pointer goes idle. It uses
the original difference blend at reduced opacity, with neutral black at rest.
The original MIT notice is in LICENSE.txt.
